steps.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the cart page says "Your cart is empty""

kane.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the cart page says "Your cart is empty""
kane.oneLiner: The run checked an active cart containing one mug, so the empty-cart message was not present.
kane.summary:
The agent treated the header count as 0 even though the displayed cart badge is 1 and the cart page shows an Ash Glaze Mug with quantity 1. It then asserted an empty-cart message without first removing the item or resetting the cart.
Reset the cart or remove all items before running these checks, and make the header-count check fail when the displayed badge is not 0.

verdict.title: Cart emptiness checks passed against a non-empty cart
verdict.oneLiner: The run checked an active cart containing one mug, so the empty-cart message was not present.
verdict.rootCause: The agent treated the header count as 0 even though the displayed cart badge is 1 and the cart page shows an Ash Glaze Mug with quantity 1. It then asserted an empty-cart message without first removing the item or resetting the cart.
verdict.suggestion: Reset the cart or remove all items before running these checks, and make the header-count check fail when the displayed badge is not 0.
